lines.text: Don't ask why my bike broke!
Long story short, my bike broke.

data.define: Used before a short version of a long story.

example.text: Long story short, my bike broke.

misuse.text: Don't say it, then tell a very long story.
misuse.why: It promises you'll keep it brief.

hook.text: Don't ask why my bike broke!

publish.title: What does "long story short" mean?
publish.value: Long story short = To make it quick. Example: "Long story short, my bike broke." (casual English).
